summary: Frontend-only visual verification of illustrations on Wallet (Plataforma de pagos) and all sector pain blocks. All 50 assertions passed: 6 wallet-feature-{0..5} + 44 pain cards across 11 sector pages loaded correctly with images (naturalWidth>0), correct src pattern ('/img/wallet-N.webp' or '/img/pain-{sector}-N.webp') and visible text. No console errors and no broken image requests observed. Layout maintains 4-column desktop grid at 1920px. Bug '/servicios/plataforma-de-pagos no tiene ilustraciones' is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: content.js is ~1280 lines; consider splitting into per-section modules for maintainability.

WalletNegocios.jsx overlays a strong dark gradient on background images (opacity-60 + gradient from-[#0B132B]); visually readable but check contrast on the two smaller cards where less image area is exposed.
Pain cards use loading=lazy with fixed h-40 image container; images do not overflow the card. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified routes: /servicios/plataforma-de-pagos (wallet-feature-0..5), /empresas/restaurantes-y-bares, /empresas/casinos, /empresas/medicos, /empresas/eventos, /servicios/cripto (each with {slug}-pain-0..3), and generic sectors /empresas/{call-center,farmacias,tiendas,ferreterias,hoteles,agencias-de-viajes} with sector-pain-0..3. Note: NAV slugs are 'medicos', 'casinos', 'eventos' (not the longer forms mentioned in the request). All /img/pain-*.webp and /img/wallet-*.webp assets exist in /app/frontend/public/img/.
